Photoshoot 1.1.0 looks and behaves like the current macOS Photo Booth.

- New default theme **Photo Booth**: dark unified titlebar, a 60 px photo tray of 3:2 thumbnails, Liquid Glass mode and Effects pills, and the glossy red shutter, all sized from a reference Photo Booth window. The five earlier themes remain in Settings.
- Countdown numerals appear in the middle of the live preview; the whole window flashes white when a photo is taken (Settings → Capture → Screen flash turns it off).
- The effects browser has black gutters, flips pages with ←/→ (Home/End), and now carries the six backdrops as its last pages with "Normal" in the centre. The Backgrounds button in the titlebar jumps straight there.
- Selecting a photo in the tray shows Share and Delete in the toolbar.
- Full screen on the green window button, F11, or ⌃⌘F.
- Includes the 1.0.2 Windows fix: the live preview and captures no longer render black on PCs with a working GPU, and every Windows build is rendered on that graphics path before it is published.

Download `Photoshoot-1.1.0-x64.exe` for the Windows 10/11 installer or `Photoshoot-1.1.0-portable.exe` for the portable app. SHA-256 hashes are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

These executables are unsigned, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning (choose More info, then Run anyway). No signed or notarised macOS release is included.

[Open the browser app](https://photoshoot-yeegz.web.app/app/).
